event.location: Forster Park Community Centre, Forster Park, Belmont WA 6104
description: Your attendance at Exercise Horizon 2026 is confirmed.

The exercise runs 07:00 to 14:00 AWST. Your own role and reporting time within that window have NOT yet been assigned - these are allocated by the Emergency Operations team and will be emailed to you closer to the date. The calendar entry stays marked [AWAITING EXTRA INFO] until then.
Location: Forster Park Community Centre (across the road from parking).
Parking: Belmont Sports & Recreation Club, 400 Abernethy Rd, Cloverdale WA 6105.
Bring: enclosed footwear, a reusable water bottle, older clothing you don't mind getting dirty (casualty roles only), and any personal medication you may need.
Full details, parking map and role descriptions: https://nicholaspagonis.github.io/Exercise-Horizon-2026
Questions: Emergency.Exercise@perthairport.com.au

extra_calendars.name: Exercise Horizon 2026 - Observer
extra_calendars.location: Airport Experience Centre, Alpha Building, 2 George Wiencke Drive, Perth Airport WA 6105
description: Your observer place at Exercise Horizon 2026 is confirmed.
Arrive 08:00 for registration and safety briefing.
Report to: Alpha Building, 2 George Wiencke Drive, Perth Airport WA 6105 - Ground Floor, Airport Experience Centre (AEC).
Parking: Alpha Building car park at the AEC. Use gate code 1023 to enter the staff car park. Your vehicle stays there all day and you return to it at the end.
Finish: from approximately 13:15, from the AEC.
HOW THE DAY RUNS
08:00 - Walk in to the Alpha Building, follow the signs to the AEC and sign in for registration, safety briefing, issue of hi-vis and conduct expectations.
08:30 - Board the bus and travel to the viewing area, in position before the exercise commences.
09:00 - Observe the multi-agency response from Emergency Gate 6 and other areas of the airfield.
11:30 - Move by bus to Forster Park to observe the reunification process.
12:30 - Lunch, provided at Forster Park by the Salvation Army.
13:15 - Return by bus to the AEC and are released to depart in your own vehicle.
BRING: enclosed footwear, weather appropriate clothing, sun protection (hat, sunglasses and sunscreen), water, photo identification, and any personal medication you may need.

PROVIDED: hi-vis vest and observer lanyard, registration and safety briefing on arrival, escorted bus transport for the full circuit, lunch at Forster Park by the Salvation Army, and on-site first aid support.

You remain escorted and within the monitored viewing area at all times. Follow the directions of exercise staff and airport authorised officers throughout the day. Observers are photographed and filmed during the exercise.
Reply with any dietary or allergy requirements, and let the team know as early as possible if your availability changes.
Questions: Emergency.Exercise@perthairport.com.au or 0439 237 973
